name: World's 30 Largest Companies
description: Reproduction of Visual Capitalist's "World's 30 Largest Companies: Profit per $100 in Revenue" (source: Fortune Global 500, 2026 fiscal data, via visualcapitalist.com). Wedge size = profit per $100 in revenue (2026), the figure displayed on each cell. Each leaf's description carries the underlying annual profit for reference.
